label: Payroll Admin
description: Runs payroll: compensation, pay configuration and payroll settings, runs, payslips, Form 16, loans, tax declarations and verifications, pay openings, and finance (expenses, vendors, budgets, card charges). An employee first (`extends: employee`). Separation of duties: approving a run, the bank file and payment results stay with super admin, and so does the switch that requires a second approver.

excluded.why: Separation of duties. Not granted rather than granted-then-denied, so no future broad grant can re-expose them: only super admin's `**` reaches them. The bank file carries the employer debit account and every account number.
Others' PII stays super-only by default.
The switch that requires a second approver on the payroll commit is super admin's, so the operator it restrains cannot turn it off.

The verification queue is reached through the `tax` capability (employees.*.tax, which payroll holds), decided per employee sub-resource - a collection grant here would be a second gate for one question.
